# MARA Schedules Conference Call for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 02, 2026 8:05 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f2b2974218238d246288891489b36239/marathondh/news/2026-11-02_MARA_Schedules_Conference_Call_for_Third_Quarter_1428.pdf)


*Earnings Webcast and Conference Call Set for* *Monday, November 9, 2026* *at* *5:00 p.m. Eastern Time*


**Miami, FL, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --**[MARA Holdings, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3YTywIhS2HXxZ4YZjRgxHEc5J9zTxV1OnVfo1fvRwifSYIBhKEdmz6QUyfZmI0I2NacLcberJYzJ0sahYwH9ScrUVL8hPoEe8m2sFI_GwVw=) **(NASDAQ:**[MARA](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3d_ah8af4-O8RVLdkxyQWTTUae269A4VqAMtOsKq4ACayphjckuT5xG1ZiyCW-4kb1iuMF8Gug7jZdKbrwJZwQ==) **) ("MARA" or the "Company")** , a leading digital energy and infrastructure company, will hold a webcast and conference call on Monday, November 9, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Financial results will be published in a shareholder letter prior to the call on the investor relations section of the Company’s[website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=h3Ni1XXRlX7BOchMm0TfUNr9xk4cf2uwj_36p8dpQN9BrOMmcfsL9EYz_pQVo42k-ypq4WMgDm0o_zBaQqec2Q==) .

**About MARA**
MARA Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA) is a global, energy-backed digital infrastructure enterprise. We acquire, develop, and operate scarce powered assets at scale, with 1.9 GW of energized capacity today across nearly 20 sites on 4 continents, and a clear path to approximately 4.8 GW. Our vertically integrated model spans power, land, and compute, designed to deliver the speed, certainty, and reliability that AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise customers need. Backed by almost a decade of operating power-intensive compute at industrial scale, Bitcoin mining is our operating foundation, providing a source of flexibility and keeping sites operating and generating revenue while we develop higher-value infrastructure paths.
